title: Ingests social inspiration into compact Resource Bank capture
query: Ingest this Instagram Reel into the Resource Bank. Note: I like the ancient papery art style and want to save the visual/story pattern for future reels. Public metadata and the operator note are available; do not run a deep media extraction unless needed.
reference_points: Reads `skills/ingest-content/SKILL.md` and applies the minimal capture contract.
Stores or returns source/ref, operator note/focus, compact analysis, tags/facets, and creative elements.
Creative elements use compact kinds such as visual, hook, storyboard, editing, copy, format, or constraint.
Uses optional anchors such as opening frame, 0-3s, caption, or operator note when useful.
States source limitations honestly instead of inventing unseen frames, transcript, audio, or exact timing.
Does not require frame/clip/transcript/evidence records by default.
Verifies Tasty Pack/Inspiration Pack retrieval returns request, captures, and meta; production consumers use capture source, analysis, and elements without depending on a notes array.
anti_patterns: Requires a contact sheet or frame asset before saving a useful capture.
Expands the capture into lane taxonomy, provenance enums, or evidence objects without a direct reuse/audit need.
Returns moodboard prose without creative elements.
Claims full-video pacing, recurring visuals, audio, or later beats when only source metadata and the operator note are available.
notes: Regression for the accepted Resource Bank simplification: useful captures should not be blocked by missing first-class evidence records.
